name: Palos Verdes Peninsula
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Reliable warmth gives very ripe fruit and a fruit-forward style rather than an earthy or mineral one.
California Chardonnay is often buttery and full bodied, from malolactic fermentation and oak.
California Pinot Noir is generally more intense and fruity than Burgundy or Oregon.
Zinfandel is powerful and fruity, with jammy flavor.
Cabernet Sauvignon ripens fully, giving fruity, full bodied wines often above 14% alcohol.

blurb.text: A California AVA on the Pacific coast of Los Angeles County, bordered by the ocean on the west and south. It takes in the cities of Palos Verdes Estates, Rolling Hills, Rolling Hills Estates and Rancho Palos Verdes, with about seven acres of commercial vineyards.
